stumbles.quote: Lock your phone's screen rotation in portrait before you start, because the game prompts you to turn the phone to landscape itself.
stumbles.why: Seems contradictory: with rotation locked in portrait, it's unclear how or why the phone would go to landscape, and the reason given doesn't explain the instruction. Does the game rotate itself, or do I physically turn the phone with the lock on?

stumbles.quote: Turn the phone to landscape when prompted and hold it at the angle you want as neutral
stumbles.why: Conflicts with the portrait lock above, and it doesn't say how the prompt appears or which landscape direction to use. The 'angle you want as neutral' is vague.

stumbles.quote: the game zeroes your tilt when the start lights go out
stumbles.why: The text never mentions start lights or a countdown. It's unclear when the neutral is captured, or whether I can still adjust before then.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone in portrait on the first screen to choose your track, laps and difficulty.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say how to choose by tilting or by touch. It also doesn't say how to advance to the race or what the options are for laps and difficulty.

stumbles.quote: Three tracks ship: Fjord, Quarry and Ring.
stumbles.why: 'Ship' is jargon, and the track names aren't explained. This is minor.

point: Open the game on a motion-sensor phone with rotation locked to portrait, pick a track, laps and difficulty, then turn the phone to landscape when prompted and tilt to steer, accelerate and brake from the neutral angle you hold at the start.
